error_class_mappings.rationale: Provider-side 408 (Request Timeout) is now classified as NON_RETRYABLE per N1.5. Immediate fallback to known-safe provider required.
Rate limit (429) is retryable with backoff. Retry first (max 2 attempts, 10s base), then fallback if exhausted.
Provider 5xx errors are transient. Retry with backoff (max 2 attempts, 10s base), then fallback.
Provider completely unavailable (DNS, connection refused). No retry - immediate fallback.
Client-side timeout (distinct from provider 408). Retry with backoff (max 2 attempts, 10s base), then fallback.
Malformed response indicates integration defect. Abort and require manual investigation. No fallback.

safety_checks.description: Verify retry policy has bounded max attempts and exponential backoff
safety_checks.details: RetryPolicy: max_attempts=2, base_delay=10s, backoff_factor=2.0. Max total wait = 10 + 20 = 30s per error class.

safety_checks.description: Verify fallback strategy prevents rapid provider switching
safety_checks.details: FallbackStrategy uses ordered list with single fallback per error. No circular fallback. Manual approval required by default.

safety_checks.description: Verify fallback chain has finite depth and terminates
safety_checks.details: Fallback chain: Primary (C3) -> Fallback (M1) -> STOP. Maximum 1 fallback hop. No recursive fallback to same provider.

safety_checks.description: Verify idempotency - same request not submitted multiple times
safety_checks.details: ProviderManager tracks attempts per request. Job identity includes source hash + config fingerprint. Duplicate submissions return same job_id.

safety_checks.description: Verify all translation outputs are captured and validated
safety_checks.details: ProductionSubmissionAdapter creates job_id with source hash. TranslationRuntime returns output path. QA validation runs on every completion.

safety_checks.description: Verify chunk-level atomicity - partial chunk failure doesn't corrupt completed chunks
safety_checks.details: TranslationRuntime processes chunks sequentially with resume state. Failed chunk retried independently. Manifest tracks per-chunk status.

safety_checks.description: Verify fallback provider (M1) is production-validated and stable
safety_checks.details: M1 (minimaxai/minimax-m3) is current production model with known behavior. 429 is provider-side issue, not model defect. RPM and timeout configs validated.

safety_checks.description: Verify fallback path respects admission control and provider governance
safety_checks.details: ProviderRouter evaluates health before fallback. controlled_provider_routing requires manual_approval_granted for fallback. Quality contract compatibility verified.

safety_checks.description: Verify fallback requests still respect RPM limits
safety_checks.details: RateLimiter applies globally across all providers. NvidiaClient has global rate lock. Fallback uses same client with same RPM limit.

safety_checks.description: Verify fallback doesn't change retry/backoff parameters
safety_checks.details: RetryPolicy is shared between primary and fallback providers. max_attempts, base_delay, backoff_factor are identical. Config loaded from provider_config.json.

contract_tests.details: Expected: fallback, Got: fallback. Rationale: Provider-side 408 (Request Timeout) is now classified as NON_RETRYABLE per N1.5. Immediate fallback to known-safe provider required.
Expected: retry, Got: retry. Rationale: Rate limit (429) is retryable with backoff. Retry first (max 2 attempts, 10s base), then fallback if exhausted.
Expected: retry, Got: retry. Rationale: Provider 5xx errors are transient. Retry with backoff (max 2 attempts, 10s base), then fallback.
Expected: fallback, Got: fallback. Rationale: Provider completely unavailable (DNS, connection refused). No retry - immediate fallback.
Expected: retry, Got: retry. Rationale: Client-side timeout (distinct from provider 408). Retry with backoff (max 2 attempts, 10s base), then fallback.
Expected: abort, Got: abort. Rationale: Malformed response indicates integration defect. Abort and require manual investigation. No fallback.
Fallback chain: C3 (primary) -> M1 (fallback) -> STOP. Max depth = 1. No further fallback from M1.
ProviderRouter checks health evidence. Fallback only allowed if fallback provider health is 'healthy' or manual approval granted.
Fallback provider (M1) uses same quality contract (literary-fidelity-zh-hant@1.0) and prompt contract (ntpe-literary-structured@1.0).
Semantic failure (quality_failure, semantic_failure) blocks both retry and fallback per controlled_provider_routing. Requires manual review.
Execution decision: authorization_consumed=True, execution_claim_consumed=True on fallback. No double-charge.

fallback_design.resume_on_fallback: TranslationRuntime resume state preserved, failed chunk retried with fallback provider
fallback_design.manual_approval: Required by default for first-time fallback. Can be pre-granted.
fallback_design.audit_trail: All fallback decisions logged with provider_request_id, nvcf_reqid, error_class, decision
fallback_design.rollback_on_semantic_failure: If fallback also fails semantic verification -> rollback to last verified draft, manual review required

gate_c_reason: All error classes mapped, all safety checks pass, all contract tests pass, production fallback not activated
